# SimplePresenter is built in three pieces:
#   proproto         ProPresenter's file formats, as C++ classes generated by protoc from
#                    the .proto files in third_party/ProPresenter7-Proto
#   SimplePresenter  the program: src/*.cpp, with the QML in qml/ and the shaders in
#                    shaders/ compiled into it, so that there is nothing to install
#                    beside the one executable
#   the package      a .deb, made by `cpack` (see the end of this file)
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)
project(SimplePresenter VERSION 0.2 LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

find_package(Qt6 6.9 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Quick Multimedia ShaderTools)
find_package(Protobuf REQUIRED)
find_package(Fontconfig REQUIRED)
find_package(ZLIB REQUIRED)
# FFmpeg's libraries, which Qt Multimedia plays video with anyway, are used directly for
# one thing: taking a single frame from a video for its thumbnail (src/videoframe.cpp).
find_package(PkgConfig REQUIRED)
pkg_check_modules(FFmpeg REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET libavformat libavcodec libswscale libavutil)
# X11's own library, for the one thing Qt has no setting for: keeping the output and stage
# windows out of the desktop's lists of windows (src/windowlists.cpp).
pkg_check_modules(XCB REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET xcb)
qt_standard_project_setup(REQUIRES 6.9)

# ProPresenter 7 document schema: the presentation and playlist documents and everything
# they import.
set(PRO_PROTO_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/ProPresenter7-Proto/autogen-proto)
set(PRO_PROTO_NAMES
    action alignmentGuide alphaType applicationInfo background collectionElementType color cue
    customOptions digitalAudio effects fileProperties font graphicsData groups hotKey input
    intRange layers messages musicKeyScale planningCenter playlist presentation
    presentationSlide propDocument propresenter propSlide rvtimestamp
    slide stage templateIdentification timers url uuid version
)
list(TRANSFORM PRO_PROTO_NAMES PREPEND ${PRO_PROTO_DIR}/ OUTPUT_VARIABLE PRO_PROTO_FILES)
list(TRANSFORM PRO_PROTO_FILES APPEND .proto)

add_library(proproto STATIC)
set_target_properties(proproto PROPERTIES AUTOMOC OFF POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
protobuf_generate(
    TARGET proproto
    LANGUAGE cpp
    PROTOS ${PRO_PROTO_FILES}
    IMPORT_DIRS ${PRO_PROTO_DIR}
    PROTOC_OUT_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/proto
)
target_include_directories(proproto PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/proto)
target_link_libraries(proproto PUBLIC protobuf::libprotobuf)

# The plain C++: files, text and thumbnails. None of this is seen from QML directly.
qt_add_executable(SimplePresenter
    src/main.cpp
    src/fontresolver.cpp
    src/fontresolver.h
    src/playlistfile.cpp
    src/playlistfile.h
    src/playlistimport.cpp
    src/playlistimport.h
    src/proconvert.cpp
    src/proconvert.h
    src/prodocument.cpp
    src/prodocument.h
    src/richtext.cpp
    src/richtext.h
    src/rtf.cpp
    src/rtf.h
    src/rtfwriter.cpp
    src/rtfwriter.h
    src/selftest.cpp
    src/selftest.h
    src/textlayout.cpp
    src/textlayout.h
    src/thumbnailprovider.cpp
    src/thumbnailprovider.h
    src/videoframe.cpp
    src/videoframe.h
    src/workspacefiles.cpp
    src/workspacefiles.h
    src/zipreader.cpp
    src/zipreader.h
)
target_include_directories(SimplePresenter PRIVATE src)

# The QML, and the C++ classes that QML uses by name (SOURCES): each of those is a type
# that QML files can create or be handed, declared with QML_ELEMENT in its header.
qt_add_qml_module(SimplePresenter
    # Not the program's own name: the module is built into a folder named after its URI,
    # which would collide with the executable.
    URI SimplePresenterApp
    VERSION 1.0
    # Qt's own QML modules are found when the program runs. Looking for them now is for
    # linking them into a program that carries Qt inside it, which this one does not;
    # here it would only print a page of warnings.
    NO_IMPORT_SCAN
    QML_FILES
        qml/AppButton.qml
        qml/AppCheck.qml
        qml/AppComboBox.qml
        qml/AppSlider.qml
        qml/AppTextField.qml
        qml/AuxWindow.qml
        qml/ColorButton.qml
        qml/Divider.qml
        qml/Editor.qml
        qml/EditorCanvas.qml
        qml/EditorInspector.qml
        qml/EmptyNote.qml
        qml/FontPicker.qml
        qml/IconButton.qml
        qml/KineticWheel.qml
        qml/LiveRing.qml
        qml/Main.qml
        qml/MediaBadge.qml
        qml/MediaBin.qml
        qml/Output.qml
        qml/PopupMenu.qml
        qml/PreviewPanel.qml
        qml/PropsLayer.qml
        qml/PropsPanel.qml
        qml/Slide.qml
        qml/SlideElement.qml
        qml/MediaContent.qml
        qml/NumberField.qml
        qml/ResizeGrips.qml
        qml/RowDrag.qml
        qml/RowIcon.qml
        qml/SectionTitle.qml
        qml/SettingsScreen.qml
        qml/ShowControl.qml
        qml/Sidebar.qml
        qml/SidebarList.qml
        qml/SlideGrid.qml
        qml/Stage.qml
        qml/StagePanel.qml
        qml/StageView.qml
        qml/TimeField.qml
        qml/TimersPanel.qml
        qml/Toolbar.qml
        qml/ToolbarIcon.qml
        qml/Transport.qml
        qml/TransitionCatalogue.qml
        qml/TransitionControls.qml
        qml/TransitionLayer.qml
        qml/TransitionOptions.qml
        qml/ZoomButtons.qml
    SOURCES
        src/catalog.h
        src/catalog.cpp
        src/firstframe.h
        src/firstframe.cpp
        src/framerelay.h
        src/framerelay.cpp
        src/presentationeditor.h
        src/presentationeditor.cpp
        src/richtextbridge.h
        src/richtextbridge.cpp
        src/strokedtext.h
        src/strokedtext.cpp
        src/timers.h
        src/timers.cpp
        src/props.h
        src/props.cpp
        src/stagelayouts.h
        src/stagelayouts.cpp
        src/show.h
        src/show.cpp
        src/sessionlog.h
        src/sessionlog.cpp
        src/windowlists.h
        src/windowlists.cpp
)

# The transitions. Compiled by qsb for every graphics backend Qt can draw with, and loaded
# as qrc:/shaders/<name>.frag.qsb. shaders/dissolve.frag says what a transition is.
qt_add_shaders(SimplePresenter "shaders"
    PREFIX "/"
    FILES
        shaders/amoeba.frag
        shaders/colorBurn.frag
        shaders/colorPush.frag
        shaders/cube.frag
        shaders/dispersionBlur.frag
        shaders/dissolve.frag
        shaders/door.frag
        shaders/doorWipe.frag
        shaders/fade.frag
        shaders/fadeBlack.frag
        shaders/fadeBright.frag
        shaders/fadeDark.frag
        shaders/fadeGray.frag
        shaders/fadeWhite.frag
        shaders/flip.frag
        shaders/flyIn.frag
        shaders/iris.frag
        shaders/mosaic.frag
        shaders/moveIn.frag
        shaders/noisyZoom.frag
        shaders/push.frag
        shaders/randomPixels.frag
        shaders/randomSquaresFlicker.frag
        shaders/reveal.frag
        shaders/ripple.frag
        shaders/swap.frag
        shaders/wipe.frag
        shaders/zoomIn.frag
        shaders/gl-transitions/circleopen.frag
        shaders/gl-transitions/crosshatch.frag
        shaders/gl-transitions/crosswarp.frag
        shaders/gl-transitions/CrossZoom.frag
        shaders/gl-transitions/directionalwarp.frag
        shaders/gl-transitions/Dreamy.frag
        shaders/gl-transitions/FilmBurn.frag
        shaders/gl-transitions/flyeye.frag
        shaders/gl-transitions/heart.frag
        shaders/gl-transitions/kaleidoscope.frag
        shaders/gl-transitions/LinearBlur.frag
        shaders/gl-transitions/pinwheel.frag
        shaders/gl-transitions/pixelize.frag
        shaders/gl-transitions/Radial.frag
        shaders/gl-transitions/randomsquares.frag
        shaders/gl-transitions/ripple.frag
        shaders/gl-transitions/SimpleZoom.frag
        shaders/gl-transitions/squareswire.frag
        shaders/gl-transitions/Swirl.frag
        shaders/gl-transitions/WaterDrop.frag
        shaders/gl-transitions/wind.frag
        shaders/gl-transitions/windowslice.frag
        shaders/gl-transitions/wipeDown.frag
        shaders/gl-transitions/wipeLeft.frag
        shaders/gl-transitions/wipeRight.frag
        shaders/gl-transitions/wipeUp.frag
)

target_link_libraries(SimplePresenter PRIVATE Qt6::Quick Qt6::Multimedia proproto Fontconfig::Fontconfig ZLIB::ZLIB
                      PkgConfig::FFmpeg PkgConfig::XCB)
# The version, for the window's title and for the log.
target_compile_definitions(SimplePresenter PRIVATE APP_VERSION="${PROJECT_VERSION}")

# Installing, and the package.
#
# `cmake --install build` puts the program, its launcher, its icon and its description
# for software centres where a desktop looks for them. `cpack` (run in the build folder)
# makes a .deb of the same. The package holds only this program: Qt, FFmpeg and the
# video drivers are the system's own, named as dependencies, so it stays small and plays
# video with whatever the machine's drivers can do.
include(GNUInstallDirs)
# The installed program uses the system's libraries, from where the system keeps them.
set_target_properties(SimplePresenter PROPERTIES INSTALL_RPATH "")
install(TARGETS SimplePresenter RUNTIME DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR})
install(FILES packaging/io.github.greyshirtguy.SimplePresenter.desktop
        DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/applications)
install(FILES packaging/io.github.greyshirtguy.SimplePresenter.svg
        DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/icons/hicolor/scalable/apps)
install(FILES packaging/io.github.greyshirtguy.SimplePresenter.metainfo.xml
        DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/metainfo)
install(FILES COPYING COPYING.LESSER DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/doc/simplepresenter)
# The GNOME Shell extension that keeps the output and stage windows out of Alt+Tab when
# the app is run through Wayland (src/windowlists.h says why it takes one). GNOME finds
# it here the next time someone logs in; it does nothing until it is switched on.
install(DIRECTORY packaging/gnome-shell-extension/simple-presenter-windows@greyshirtguy.github.io
        DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/gnome-shell/extensions)

set(CPACK_GENERATOR DEB)
set(CPACK_PACKAGE_NAME simplepresenter)
set(CPACK_PACKAGE_VERSION ${PROJECT_VERSION})
set(CPACK_PACKAGE_DESCRIPTION_SUMMARY "Run ProPresenter presentations and media on a second screen")
set(CPACK_PACKAGE_DESCRIPTION "A simple, lightweight presenter that works on ProPresenter 7 folders as they
are: presentations, playlists and media, with a slide layer over a media layer, shader
transitions, an audience output and a stage display. A personal experiment in vibe
coding, not a product: nobody supports it, and it comes with no warranty.")
set(CPACK_PACKAGE_CONTACT "greyshirtguy <greyshirtguy@users.noreply.github.com>")
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_HOMEPAGE "https://github.com/greyshirtguy/Simple-Presenter")
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_SECTION video)
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_FILE_NAME DEB-DEFAULT)
set(CPACK_STRIP_FILES ON)
set(CPACK_INSTALL_DEFAULT_DIRECTORY_PERMISSIONS
    OWNER_READ OWNER_WRITE OWNER_EXECUTE GROUP_READ GROUP_EXECUTE WORLD_READ WORLD_EXECUTE)
# The libraries the program is linked with are found by looking at it. What it loads
# when it runs is not linked, and has to be named: the QML modules it imports, Qt's
# support for Wayland (without which it would run through the X11 stand-in), and Qt's
# readers for the picture formats that are not built into it, WebP among them.
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_SHLIBDEPS ON)
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_DEPENDS "qml6-module-qtcore, qml6-module-qtquick, qml6-module-qtquick-controls, \
qml6-module-qtquick-dialogs, qml6-module-qtquick-effects, qml6-module-qtquick-shapes, qml6-module-qtquick-window, \
qml6-module-qtmultimedia, qt6-wayland, qt6-image-formats-plugins")
# The desktop's own file dialogs, and the drivers that decode video on Intel graphics
# hardware (AMD's come with the desktop): without one video still plays, decoded by the
# processor.
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_RECOMMENDS "qt6-gtk-platformtheme, va-driver-all")
include(CPack)
